name: Jardin Zoo-Botanique de Mvog-Betsi
description: A botanical garden and zoo located in Yaoundé, Cameroon, offering a diverse range of flora and fauna.
bonASavoir: to visit the zoo as a foreigner you will pay more(1000-2000 XAF) and have to bring a identification piece(passport or ID card) and the entrance fee is 2000 XAF for foreigners and 1000 XAF for nationals
